purpose: Record lessons from the 2026 official Melbourne Cup weights without altering the frozen 13 September pre-release prediction snapshot.

sources.name: Racing Victoria Handicapping
sources.finding: Feature-race handicapping can adjust ratings for direct relativities, previous feature-race form and peak performance; the Melbourne Cup has a 59kg minimum topweight and 51kg minimum for older horses, with 49kg minimum for three-year-olds.

sources.name: Racing Victoria 2025 Melbourne Cup weights release
sources.finding: NH three-year-old St Leger winner Scandinavia was assigned 55.5kg, described as 1kg below WFA; prior St Leger winners Kew Gardens and Jan Brueghel were cited as receiving 0.5kg less above the minimum than Scandinavia.

nh3yoFinding.description: The frozen model treated the NH 3YO age allowance too aggressively. Official 2026 weights show that elite or high-class NH 3YOs can sit deep into the open-age Cup handicap rather than clustering near the 49kg three-year-old minimum.

methodologyForFutureResearch: Do not anchor NH 3YO estimates to the 49kg race minimum. The minimum is a floor, not a class benchmark.
Estimate underlying relative handicap merit first, then apply age/sex treatment and the race-wide scale independently.

For elite NH 3YOs, explicitly compare the horse with historical NH 3YO Cup allocations and its WFA relationship; St Leger/elite open-age evidence must be capable of producing mid-to-upper-50kg Cup weights.
Model the mandatory minimum-topweight uplift as a separate uniform scale transformation when required rather than embedding it horse-by-horse.
Retain feature-race relativities and handicapper discretion as explicit uncertainty drivers; international ratings are evidence, not a direct kilograms conversion.
Keep qualification/inactive status separate from handicap merit so cases such as Constitution Hill do not contaminate active-contender calibration.
Validate any revised methodology on historical Cups before using it prospectively. Do not fit a new rule solely to the 2026 outcomes.

governance.rule: Never overwrite the frozen prediction snapshot. Post-release learning must be versioned separately and tested out-of-sample before promotion.
